# Check kinds

Each check in `[checks.<name>]` names one of these kinds. Cheaper tiers run first. By default a model-backed kind cannot justify a block on its own, and its evidence never reaches a template.

| Kind           | Tier           | Output | Model-backed |
| -------------- | -------------- | ------ | ------------ |
| `cwd_glob`     | 0 (in-process) | bool   | no           |
| `host`         | 0 (in-process) | bool   | no           |
| `keywords`     | 0 (in-process) | bool   | no           |
| `origin`       | 0 (in-process) | bool   | no           |
| `path_exists`  | 0 (in-process) | bool   | no           |
| `regex`        | 0 (in-process) | bool   | no           |
| `regex_groups` | 0 (in-process) | bool   | no           |
| `tool`         | 0 (in-process) | bool   | no           |

## `cwd_glob`

True when the working folder matches one of the globs.

| Option     | Meaning                                    |
| ---------- | ------------------------------------------ |
| `patterns` | globs with *, ** and ?; ~/ expands to home |

## `host`

True when the agent client matches: its id, a version range, or the effects it supports on this event. Unknown version gives unknown.

| Option     | Meaning                                     |
| ---------- | ------------------------------------------- |
| `id`       | list of host ids, e.g. ["codex"]            |
| `version`  | range such as ">=0.40" or ">=1.2 <2"        |
| `supports` | list of effects that must be supported here |

## `keywords`

True when any (or all) of the words appear as whole words, case-insensitive by default.

| Option           | Meaning                               |
| ---------------- | ------------------------------------- |
| `words`          | list of literal words or phrases      |
| `whole_word`     | default true                          |
| `case_sensitive` | default false                         |
| `match`          | "any" (default) or "all"              |
| `field`          | event field to read, default "prompt" |

## `origin`

True when the prompt origin is one of the listed values.

| Option | Meaning                             |
| ------ | ----------------------------------- |
| `is`   | list of "user", "system", "unknown" |

## `path_exists`

True when any (or all) paths exist, relative to the working folder.

| Option  | Meaning                  |
| ------- | ------------------------ |
| `paths` | list of paths            |
| `match` | "any" (default) or "all" |

## `regex`

True when any (or all) of the patterns match the field.

| Option     | Meaning                                    |
| ---------- | ------------------------------------------ |
| `patterns` | list of regex sources (max 300 chars each) |
| `flags`    | subset of "imsu", default "iu"             |
| `match`    | "any" (default) or "all"                   |
| `field`    | event field to read, default "prompt"      |

## `regex_groups`

Named groups of patterns; true when every group in at least one fire_when combination matches.

| Option      | Meaning                               |
| ----------- | ------------------------------------- |
| `groups`    | table of group name to pattern list   |
| `fire_when` | list of group-name lists              |
| `flags`     | subset of "imsu", default "iu"        |
| `field`     | event field to read, default "prompt" |

## `tool`

True when the tool call names one of these tools (canonical or host name).

| Option  | Meaning                        |
| ------- | ------------------------------ |
| `names` | list such as ["Bash", "Write"] |
